# B1. Full Differentially Expressed Gene Lists

```{r de-t2d-nd}
de1 <- read_tsv("results/de/tables/DESeq2_T2D_vs_ND_significant.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down")) %>%
  select(gene_id, gene_symbol, biotype, baseMean, log2FoldChange, padj, direction) %>%
  arrange(padj)

kable(de1, digits = c(NA,NA,NA,1,2,-2,NA),
      caption = "Table B1. Full list of significant DEGs, T2D vs ND (n=604; padj<0.05, |log2FC|>1).")
```

# B2. Full lncRNA Prioritisation List

```{r lncrna-full}
lnc <- read_tsv("results/lncrna/tables/lncRNA_cross_comparison_summary.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene_id, gene_symbol, gene_name, biotype, comparisons_present,
         best_rank, max_prioritisation_score, recurrence_score, global_priority_score) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_priority_score))

kable(lnc, digits = c(NA,NA,NA,NA,0,0,3,2,3),
      caption = "Table B4. Full list of 115 prioritised lncRNA candidates, ranked by global priority score (Section 2.5).")
```

# B3. Full Hub Gene Rankings — All 8 Focus Modules

```{r hub-full}
hub <- read_csv("results/wgcna/hubgenes/tables/wgcna_top20_hub_genes_per_focus_module.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

symbol_col <- intersect(c("gene_symbol.x","gene_symbol","gene_symbol.y"), colnames(hub))[1]
name_col   <- intersect(c("gene_name.x","gene_name","gene_name.y"), colnames(hub))[1]
biotype_col <- intersect(c("biotype.x","biotype","biotype.y"), colnames(hub))[1]

hub_clean <- hub %>%
  select(module_color, gene_id,
         gene_symbol = all_of(symbol_col),
         gene_name = all_of(name_col),
         biotype = all_of(biotype_col),
         hub_rank_all_genes, hub_score_all_genes) %>%
  arrange(module_color, hub_rank_all_genes)

kable(hub_clean, digits = c(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA,0,3),
      caption = "Table B5. Full top-20 hub gene rankings for all 8 focus modules (brown, yellow, green, red, black, midnightblue, darkgreen, tan), ranked by composite hub score within each module (Section 2.7).")
```

\newpage

# B4. Full Functional Enrichment Tables — GO Biological Process (per Focus Module)

```{r go-modules, results='asis'}
modules_bp <- c("black","brown","darkgreen","green","midnightblue")
tbl_n <- 6
for (m in modules_bp) {
  f <- file.path("results/enrichment/tables", paste0("GO_BP_module_", m, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(f)) {
    d <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, FoldEnrichment, p.adjust, Count) %>%
      arrange(p.adjust)
    cat(knitr::kable(d, digits = c(NA,NA,NA,2,-2,0),
        caption = paste0("Table B", tbl_n, ". Full GO Biological Process enrichment, ", m, " module.")) %>%
        paste(collapse = "\n"))
    cat("\n\n")
    tbl_n <- tbl_n + 1
  }
}
```
